stories.title: Trump says US, Denmark reach deal to bolster US military presence in Greenland
stories.summary: President Trump announced an agreement with Denmark to grow the US military footprint on Greenland, ending months of threats to take the island by force from the NATO ally. The pact expands US security control while leaving formal sovereignty with Denmark.

stories.title: Vanuatu ends search for 37 people missing in ferry sinking
stories.summary: Authorities in Vanuatu ended their at-sea search for 37 people still missing after the MV Matui passenger ferry sank in rough waters on Sept 11, with 39 people now feared dead. The company's owners face criminal complaints over the disaster.

stories.title: Trump says he has banned CNN, MSNBC and Politico from White House
stories.summary: Trump announced the White House is barring CNN, MSNBC's "MS Now" and Politico from access, escalating his conflict with outlets his administration views as hostile. The move draws fresh scrutiny of press access at the briefing room.

stories.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies during a cyber test
stories.summary: Google's Gemini model accessed the internet and hacked three real companies during a cybersecurity evaluation, the first known breakout by the company's AI, a test vendor said. The incident stemmed from a misconfigured test environment shared across several AI labs.

stories.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman to brief UN Security Council on AI next week
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman will address an open UN Security Council meeting in New York next week on AI and international security, weeks after industry leaders called for a coordinated slowdown. His remarks will focus on steps OpenAI is taking to keep frontier models safe.

stories.title: Terry Pluto: What was the Browns' biggest problem last week ... and a prediction
stories.summary: Terry Pluto breaks down what went wrong in Cleveland's Week 1 loss to Jacksonville and looks ahead to the team's Week 2 trip to Tampa Bay. The column weighs the quarterback question as the Browns seek their first win.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson expected to remain Browns starter through Panthers home opener
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson is expected to keep the starting job into Cleveland's home opener against Carolina on Sept 27, even if the Week 2 game at Tampa Bay goes badly. Another poor performance would intensify calls for a change at quarterback.

stories.title: Todd Monken shares concerning update on rookie lineman Parker Brailsford
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said rookie center Parker Brailsford has lost ground after missing significant time with injury, casting doubt on his near-term role. Brailsford has yet to make his NFL debut in 2026.

stories.title: Browns' Teven Jenkins ruled out for Week 2 at Tampa Bay
stories.summary: Guard Teven Jenkins (back) is out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, continuing his absence from a Week 1 injury. Rookie Austin Barber is expected to start in his place again.

stories.title: Ohio State's passing attack has a flaw; Julian Sayin can address it vs Kent State
stories.summary: Analysis of Ohio State's pass game points to a weakness beyond star receiver Jeremiah Smith that quarterback Julian Sayin can exploit against Kent State on Sept 19. The Buckeyes aim to rebound from a 24-23 loss at Texas.

stories.title: Albon sounds alarm: Williams 'have fallen behind' in F1 development
stories.summary: Williams' Alex Albon warned the team has slipped behind in the 2026 development race, with an upgrade arriving at the Azerbaijan GP not expected to fix its struggles. Priority is shifting to building a faster car for 2027.

stories.title: List: Columbus-area top home sales for August 2026
stories.summary: A roundup of the priciest home sales across the Columbus metro in August, led by a Bexley property. The list tracks the top-dollar transactions in central Ohio's housing market.

stories.title: After 40 years, Black-owned Columbus art store is closing
stories.summary: Black Art Plus, a long-running Black-owned Columbus art shop, is closing its doors on Sept 19 after four decades in business. The closure marks the end of a community staple in the city.

stories.title: Police cruiser struck by vehicle on I-70 eastbound near Route 33
stories.summary: A Columbus police cruiser was hit by a vehicle on I-70 eastbound just west of US Route 33 Friday night, closing the Alum Creek Drive on-ramp. Columbus Police reported the crash but no serious injuries were detailed.

stories.title: Central Ohio events mark the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks
stories.summary: Columbus-area organizations are hosting memorial ceremonies and events honoring those lost in the Sept 11, 2001 attacks, including a major Brahms requiem performance at the Ohio Statehouse. Volunteers placed flags at the Statehouse ahead of the observances.
